name: Play Most Recent Rosbag
description: Plays the most recent .bag file from a directory on the rosbot_pc agent. Spawns rosbag play as a long-lived named process via the exec component; stop with exec.kill name=rosbag_play. Requires roscore reachable at ros_master_uri.

agent_id.description: Agent that holds the bags and will play them

bag_dir.description: Directory to scan for the newest *.bag file

process_name.description: exec.spawn process name; use this with exec.kill to stop playback

ros_setup.description: Base ROS setup script sourced before playback

ws_setup.description: Workspace overlay sourced after the base ROS setup

timeout_s.description: exec.spawn handshake timeout (does NOT cap bag duration)

params.name: ${process_name}
params.command: bash -c 'BAG=$(ls -t "${bag_dir}"/*.bag 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$BAG" ] && { echo "no .bag in ${bag_dir}" >&2; exit 2; }; echo "Playing: $BAG"; source ${ros_setup} && source ${ws_setup} && export ROS_MASTER_URI=${ros_master_uri} && exec rosbag play "$BAG"'
